_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): react-hook-form scaffold — fields, validation, submit. Requires react-hook-form.
name: comp-form
description: React form scaffold (react-hook-form): typed fields, validation rules, submit handler. Requires: npm install react-hook-form.
notes: Usage: <AppForm fields={[{name:'email', label:'Email', rules:{required:'Email is required'}}]} onSubmit={handler} submitLabel="Save" />. Renders labeled inputs with error messages.
